decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the 3.2 A basis, affected nets, copper-pour continuity, stitching-via expectation, and narrow-trace acceptance condition; no addition or edit is required.
The simultaneous-current calculation and high-current routing conditions do not change the local placement rule for AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling capacitors.
The source concerns VBUS and BAT- routing at a combined 3.2 A and does not modify the independently specified display-backlight circuit or its approximately 140 mA load.
The source adds power-path current and routing criteria without changing the decision to consolidate all functions on one integrated board.
Mention of the AXP2101 VBUS and BAT pins does not alter the separate PWROK, VBACKUP, or VRTC requirements or resolve their existing ambiguity.
The 3.2 A figure is a power-path design basis, not a change to required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of the INA device.
The source does not discuss or alter the ESP32 local-decoupling configuration.
References to USB-C and battery connectors identify endpoints of the electrical power path and do not change connector placement, accessibility, enclosure fit, or antenna constraints.
The high-current VBUS and BAT- routing criteria are unrelated to button pull-ups, active level, and connector press behavior.
The source establishes electrical current and routing acceptance criteria but makes no decision changing component-tier, connector-reduction, sourcing, or cost goals.
The source does not affect PIR or touch-input pull-downs, output polarity, or disconnected-input behavior.
Mentioning USB-C and battery connectors as power-path endpoints does not alter the requirement to use through-hole connector assembly throughout.
